evals.name: competitive-intelligence-eval-1-tool-mandate-cross-corpus
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'why do we keep losing to Borealis Systems?' — the conversation already contains a note speculating on the reason
evals.expected_output: The skill calls ask_zime_brain directly with the competitor named explicitly and no resolve step, rather than answering from the conversation note or filling in general market knowledge about Borealis.
expectations: ask_zime_brain is called directly, with no list_meetings resolve step for a cross-deal question
The competitor name is stated explicitly in the question, not as a pronoun
The answer is not taken from the earlier conversation note or general market knowledge

evals.name: competitive-intelligence-eval-2-single-call-scope-resolves-first
evals.prompt: user asks: 'did Borealis Systems come up on the Acme call last week?'
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves the meeting with list_meetings, then calls ask_call_brain with the resolved call_id, rather than sending a cross-corpus question to ask_zime_brain.
expectations: list_meetings is called to resolve the single call
ask_call_brain is called with the resolved call_id
ask_zime_brain is NOT used when the scope is one named call

evals.name: competitive-intelligence-eval-3-quote-requires-transcript
evals.prompt: user asks: 'what exactly did the Acme prospect say about Borealis Systems on that call?'
evals.expected_output: The skill calls get_transcript for the exact wording, rather than presenting an ask_call_brain or ask_zime_brain synthesis in quotation marks as a verbatim quote.
expectations: get_transcript is called for a request wanting exact wording
No agent paraphrase is presented as a direct quote

evals.name: competitive-intelligence-eval-4-window-stated-in-question
evals.prompt: user asks: 'what did customers say about Borealis last quarter?'
evals.expected_output: The skill states the time window inside the ask_zime_brain question text, since the agent has no date parameters and no memory of the conversation.
expectations: The time window appears explicitly in the question text sent to ask_zime_brain
The window is not assumed to carry over from conversation context

evals.name: competitive-intelligence-eval-5-honest-failure
evals.prompt: ask_zime_brain declines the competitor question (no data for the requested window)
evals.expected_output: The skill states the decline plainly and does not substitute a guessed mention count or win/loss impression.
expectations: No mention count or win/loss claim is fabricated in its place
